4.	According to local legend, this city was founded by Shem, the son of Noah, who walked south after the Great Flood and laid out its first walls. This is one of the world’s oldest continuously inhabited human settlements. Its Old City — a UNESCO World Heritage Site — is famous for its remarkable multi-story tower houses, built of rammed earth and dark basalt and decorated with delicate white gypsum tracings around every window. Since 2014, the city has been a battle zone in a civil war.
